SELECT DISTINCT STRUCTURE_NAME FROM T_MDM_SKU_STRUCTURE_REF WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND STRUCTURE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND MATERIAL_CODE = #{materialCode} AND MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC = #{mainMaterialDesc} AND STRUCTURE_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{structureName}), '%')
GROUP BY STRUCTURE_NAME
SELECT a.* FROM T_MDM_SKU_STRUCTURE_REF a LEFT JOIN T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO b ON a.MATERIAL_CODE = b.MATERIAL_CODE ${ew.customSqlSegment}
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO t1 JOIN T_MDM_SKU_STRUCTURE_REF t2 ON t1.FACTORY_CODE = t2.FACTORY_CODE AND t1.MATERIAL_CODE = t2.MATERIAL_CODE AND t2.IS_DELETE = 0 SET t1.STRUCTURE_NAME = t2.STRUCTURE_NAME, t1.UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy}, t1.UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime} WHERE t1.IS_DELETE = 0
